title: No Anvil Expensive
body:
# 🔨 NoAnvilExpensive — Break the Anvil Limits!

Have you ever spent hours grinding for perfect enchantments in your personal survival world, only to place your favorite netherite sword into an anvil and see those frustrating red words: **"Too Expensive!"**?

In vanilla Minecraft, the game imposes an arbitrary 40-level limit on anvil operations. Every time you repair an item or add an enchantment, its hidden "prior work penalty" increases. Eventually, the game completely locks you out, forcing you to watch your legendary gear break forever.

**NoAnvilExpensive** is a lightweight Fabric mod designed specifically for **Singleplayer** and **LAN** play. It completely deletes this restriction from the internal game logic, allowing you and your friends to use anvils without any limits!

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Complete Cap Removal:** Completely eradicates the vanilla 40-level restriction. If an operation costs 42, 75, or 120 levels, the anvil will let you do it, provided you have the experience.
* **Infinite Gear Longevity:** Repair your favorite armor, tools, and weapons an infinite number of times. You will never have to craft a replacement piece of gear just because an anvil rejected it.
* **Ultimate Enchantment Combining:** Want to combine five different enchanted books to create the ultimate bow or helmet? Go right ahead. The mod dynamically handles the scaling cost without ever cutting you off.
* **LAN Multiplayer Support:** Open your world to your friends and play together! As long as everyone has the mod installed, everyone can enjoy unlimited anvil repairs.

---

## 🎮 How It Changes Your Experience

Without this mod, you are forced to use hyper-specific, confusing enchantment order guides just to avoid hitting the cap. If you make a mistake, your hard-earned item is permanently ruined. 

With **NoAnvilExpensive**, you can experience your world with true freedom:
* **Endgame Security:** Your god-tier armor sets are safe forever. As long as you have an experience farm in your world, you can maintain your gear indefinitely.
* **Stress-Free Enchanting:** Order no longer matters. Combine books in whatever way is convenient for you.
* **Co-op Ready:** Perfect for small private sessions when you open your world to LAN to play with a friend.

---

## 🛠 Technical Specifications & Requirements

| Detail | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **Supported Game Versions** | 1.21.4, 1.21.8, 1.21.11 |
| **Environment** | Client & Server (Integrated LAN) |

> ⚠️ **Important Requirement for LAN:** 
> If you open your world for friends to play over the local network (LAN), **every player** joining your world must have this mod installed in their game. 
> 
> *(Note: This mod is optimized for Singleplayer/LAN worlds and is not meant for dedicated standalone servers).*
